nodes.description: Owner address of UniswapExchange; gates delegate/init/batchSend/setTradeAddress and is used as a whitelist bypass key in ensure().
public mapping(address=>uint) holding token balances; written with raw arithmetic in transferFrom and batchSend.
public nested mapping(address=>mapping(address=>uint)) of spender approvals; decremented without SafeMath in transferFrom.
private per-address sale counter incremented on every transferFrom and checked in condition().
private mapping(address=>bool) whitelist that makes ensure() return true and skip all transfer conditions.
private minimum sale value used by condition().
private maximum sale value used by condition().
private maximum number of sales per address used by condition().
private address that is also treated as a bypassing white-listed sender in ensure().
public total supply, fixed at construction time.
payable public transfer(address _to, uint _value) that unconditionally forwards to transferFrom(msg.sender,_to,_value).
internal view gate that returns true for owner/UNI/pair/tradeAddress/canSale senders and otherwise requires condition().
payable public transferFrom(address _from,address _to,uint _value) that mutates allowance/balanceOf with unchecked arithmetic.
payable public approve(address _spender,uint _value) writing allowance[msg.sender][_spender].
internal view that enforces _saleNum/_minSale/_maxSale limits for non-whitelisted senders.
payable public delegate(address a, bytes b) gated by require(msg.sender==owner) that delegatecalls arbitrary code.
owner-only initializer setting _minSale/_maxSale/_saleNum from decimals-scaled inputs.
owner-only payable loop sending _value to each address in _tos and emitting Transfer twice per recipient.
owner-only setter for tradeAddress.
internal pure Uniswap-V2 pair address derivation via CREATE2 hash.
payable constructor minting the whole supply to msg.sender and setting owner.
internal view in Context returning msg.sender.
Caller-controlled origin of every external entry point; used for auth checks and balance/allowance ownership.
a.delegatecall(b) in delegate() executes attacker/owner supplied code against this contract's storage.
address(token).call(data) in SafeERC20.callOptionalReturn forwards arbitrary calldata to an external token.
ensure() short-circuits to true for owner/UNI/pair/tradeAddress/canSale senders, skipping ALL sale limits and gating conditions.
batchSend computes total = _value * _tos.length and emits Transfer twice with _value/2, breaking accounting and events.
transferFrom uses raw += / -= on balanceOf and allowance instead of SafeMath, plus a state increment after external ensure call.
recipient parameter of transfer/transferFrom.
value parameter of transfer/transferFrom/batchSend.
source parameter of transferFrom/ensure.
spender parameter of approve.
target address parameter of delegate(), the delegatecall destination.
calldata parameter of delegate(), the delegatecall payload.
saleNum parameter of init().
token parameter of init(), the minimum sale amount.
maxToken parameter of init(), the maximum sale amount.
recipient array parameter of batchSend.
address parameter of setTradeAddress.
local in batchSend = _value * _tos.length.
loop index local in batchSend.
private SafeERC20 helper that validates the target is a contract then performs a low-level call.

msg.sender is the allowance owner key written in approve().
require(msg.sender == owner) guards delegate(); a single key controls arbitrary delegatecall.
require(msg.sender == owner) guards init().
require(msg.sender == owner) guards batchSend().
require(msg.sender == owner) guards setTradeAddress().
msg.sender is assigned to owner and receives the entire supply in the constructor.
Context._msgSender() simply returns msg.sender.

_from indexes balanceOf and _onSaleNum during transferFrom().
_value is passed to condition() from ensure().
_value drives allowance and balance arithmetic in transferFrom().
_to receives the credited balance in transferFrom().
_to is forwarded unchanged from transfer() into transferFrom().
_spender is the spender key written in approve().
the caller-supplied address a selects the delegatecall target.
the caller-supplied bytes b become the delegatecall payload.
attacker-influenced target a flows directly into the delegatecall sink.
saleNum is stored into _saleNum.
token scales into _minSale.
maxToken scales into _maxSale.
_tos supplies every recipient credited in batchSend().
addr is written into tradeAddress, creating a permanent bypass identity.
total = _value * _tos.length is computed without SafeMath and used for the balance debit.
loop counter i walks the recipient array in batchSend().
transfer() unconditionally forwards execution to transferFrom().
transferFrom() invokes ensure() before mutating any balance.
ensure() calls condition() for addresses that are not whitelisted.
the whitelist branch of ensure() returns true and bypasses every sale condition for owner/UNI/pair/tradeAddress/canSale.
delegate() executes the delegatecall to a caller-supplied address after only an owner check.
batchSend performs the unchecked multiplication and the duplicated Transfer emissions.
transferFrom mutates allowance, balanceOf and _onSaleNum with raw arithmetic operators.
callOptionalReturn passes abi-encoded data into the low-level call sink.
arbitrary delegatecall code executes in this contract's context and can re-enter transferFrom/transfer before state settles.
delegatecall runs against this contract's storage, so the owner slot can be overwritten by the delegated code.
